ROW.COLUMN: (ML/EN) External Entity Identifier Associated with Multiple, Recurring Names

Money launderers may attempt to conceal their true identity by providing false names and/or identifiers. Launderers and their agents may utilize various (sometimes fictitious) names when purchasing or redeeming strings of monetary instruments and sending or receiving funds transfers. For example, to help avoid detection and stay under the radar, the money launderer may utilize different names when conducting various transactions at different times or in different locations. This scenario identifies possible attempts to conceal the true identity of the parties involved by providing false names when purchasing or redeeming monetary instruments, and sending or receiving electronic transactions.

Step[1] Dataset consisting of records from monetary and wire transaction tables for specified lookback period and frequency period.
Step[2] Filtering records based on the specified conditions.
Step[3] Appendind data with Transaction Seq ID of matched transactions.
